_note: Captured read-only through the Upwork MCP on 2026-08-27 ~00:45 IST (Abhijeet's approval: 'Yes, all four'), CLIENT org 1715797263477194752 — the hiring side. Four tools. Structure verbatim; cover letters truncated with ' [...]'. THE FINDINGS: (1) get_job_posting action=list is PAGE-based (has_more + next_page), not cursor-based, and it already carries the whole applicant funnel — applicants, new_applicants, shortlisted, messaged, offered, hired, pending_invitations — so 'how many applied' needs no second call. (2) get_client_dashboard action=check returns every proposal's FULL cover letter inline; it is the wrong tool for the applicant list (thousands of characters a run). list_client_proposals action=list returns the same rows with a `cover_letter_snippet` and a totalCount, which is what the rail reads. (3) SHORTLISTED AND READ ARE ANNOTATIONS, not statuses: annotations[] carries Read, Shortlisted, Recommended, Sponsored. `status.status` is the client-side vocabulary (Created = applied, Activated = invitation accepted, Archived), NOT the freelancer-side one. (4) `bid` is a display string ('USD 10.0'); the wire's rawValue is EMPTY on this side, so the number is parsed out of the display value or it is not known. (5) get_rate_insights REQUIRES this client org (it refuses the freelancer org) and answers with an occupation it inferred from the text, plus the sample size. Live reading: the LinkedIn Ghostwriter post has 9 applicants, 4 unlooked-at, 6 shortlisted, 0 offered; the market for expert Content Strategy is $15-35/h and the bids run $8-27.
